subject: Request to pause walkthrough due to exec travel & FY budget reset
messages:
From: Dana Hughes <dana.hughes@evermere.com>
To: soojin_lee@redwood.com
Cc: procurement@evermere.com
Date: Sun, 15 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Request to pause walkthrough due to CFO travel & FY reset

Hi Soojin,

Appreciate you lining up the product walkthrough for next week. I wanted to flag a change on our side: our CFO is traveling for two weeks starting Monday and our FP&A team has been asked to pause open procurement requests until the FY24 planning offsite concludes on Nov 30. The procurement committee has asked us to consolidate demos/presentations into the first week of December to make approval decisions in batch.

Given that, can we pause the live walkthrough and target a tentative slot after Dec 1? In the meantime our team would still like access to a short recording or a 20–30 minute on-demand summary to share with the committee.

I've attached the SOW draft and the procurement questionnaire the committee uses — they'll want to see both before any spend gets committed.

Apologies for the churn — this is a budget timing issue rather than a product concern. Please advise on next steps and whether you can reserve capacity for an early-December pilot window.

Thanks,
Dana Hughes
Director, Strategic Procurement
Evermere Inc.
Attachment: SOW_draft.pdf
Attachment: Evermere_Questionnaire.xlsx

From: soojin_lee@redwood.com <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
To: Dana Hughes <dana.hughes@evermere.com>
Cc: karthik_iyer@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 16 Nov 2026 10:07:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Request to pause walkthrough due to CFO travel & FY reset

Hi Dana — thanks for the heads up and for sharing the SOW/questionnaire. Totally understand the budget batching — we've seen this pattern and can adapt.

Options from our side:
- We can provide a crisp 18-minute recorded walkthrough (focused on integration, security controls, and expected cost/latency tradeoffs) that your team can circulate immediately. I can also include a short annotated appendix with suggested scope for a 30-day pilot.
- Hold the live executive walkthrough until the week of Dec 6–10; we can tentatively reserve two 30-minute executive slots on Dec 8 and Dec 9 and firm up once your CFO returns.
- If helpful, we can also provision a short proof-of-value sandbox (no charge) to start once the committee signs the attached MOU; that would let your engineers validate integration before formal procurement.

I've attached a condensed deck (redwood_quickwalk.pdf) that matches the 18-minute recording outline. I'm copying Karthik (AE lead) to loop him in on scheduling and the potential pilot.

If you want the recording now, I'll send a link today and follow up with available Dec exec slots.

Best,
Soojin Lee
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference
soojin_lee@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0123
Attachment: redwood_quickwalk.pdf

Hi Dana — Karthik here. Appreciate the transparency. A couple quick items from our side to make the December window low-friction for procurement and engineering: 

1) We can prepare a short MOU / statement of work that covers a 30-day proof-of-value with clear success criteria and a temporary price hold (quotes valid for 45 days) so finance has something to review while the CFO is out. I'll attach the MOU draft to this thread for your legal/procurement folks.

2) If you opt for the on-demand recording now, our solution architect can also drop in a 15-minute technical appendix targeted at your infra/ops team to preempt any security/compliance questions.

3) Logistics: to reserve a Dec 8 exec slot I just need a tentative go/no-go by Nov 24; otherwise we'll release that slot.

Marissa — can CS prepare the POV sandbox checklist and a quick deployment ETA?

Thanks — happy to coordinate the DocuSign flow once Dana confirms.

Best,
Karthik Iyer
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
Attachment: MOU_draft.docx

From: Dana Hughes <dana.hughes@evermere.com>
To: soojin_lee@redwood.com, karthik_iyer@redwood.com
Cc: procurement@evermere.com
Date: Wed, 18 Nov 2026 14:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Request to pause walkthrough due to CFO travel & FY reset

Soojin / Karthik — this is helpful, thank you. Two quick confirmations from procurement:

1) Please send the 18-minute on-demand recording and the technical appendix today — we'll circulate internally and that should keep the committee moving.
2) We're tentatively reserving Dec 8 at 10:00 AM EST for the live exec briefing (pending CFO confirmation). Please hold that time; we'll confirm by Nov 24 as requested.

Also, procurement would prefer the MOU via DocuSign rather than a PDF attachment — can you route the MOU that way when it's ready? We'll route the questionnaire and any comments back to you by end of week.

Thanks,
Dana Hughes
Director, Strategic Procurement
Evermere Inc.
Attachment: Evermere_Questionnaire.xlsx (updated)
